svg.title: OpenFilm release readiness evidence snapshot
svg.desc: On main 9b8df86, the reviewed GLib source repair and audiovisual comparison/export tail review are merged. Source-only candidate 54534d8 is merged to the release/v0.5.0 branch, with no tag or publication. The owner accepted the disclosed maintenance warning only for this branch update. A later compressed archive differs in digest although all 1,417 Git-tree file contents match. Installer signing and real Windows/macOS acceptance remain unverified.
